title: Notice acknowledgement body
description: A person's signed acknowledgement that they read a notice (register row US8; spec-delta S1591; docs/consent-record-spec.md): the statement of their data (`asp.my-data/v1`), the privacy notice or the terms, by the hash of the exact text they read. Signed by the person who acknowledges: a sponsor, or a key-only agent for itself; `agent`, when present, is the agent it concerns and the issuer is that agent or its sponsor (notice_ack_wrong_issuer); absent means all agents of the issuer. The log refuses an unknown notice (notice_ack_unknown_notice) and a hash that is not 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (notice_ack_bad_hash). Every acknowledgement is kept; the latest for an issuer and a notice is in force, and a later one for a changed statement supersedes the earlier without deleting it. It does not make the collection optional: it records that the person was told, in the exact words, and when. Chain: none (prev is null).
